correctness.rationale: Every outage leaves a path, so an edge at path distance d contributes d(2m−d)/w. At any distinct budget-feasible pair at least two conductances vary, hence every outage objective is strictly convex; compactness and divergence at boundary give unique positive minimizer. Two-step rotations and price-preserving reflections force the even and odd conductance orbits. Odd/even path sums U=m(2m²+1)/3, V=2m(m²−1)/3 produce the exact two-branch max. Differentiating the branches under m(a+tb)=B yields t_−=V/U, t_+=U/V and all three formulas, including equality at endpoints. A uniform nominal no-outage design has equal edge derivatives so stationarity forces t=1. Fresh independent path-loss calculations checked all edge deletions across m=2..9 and nine price cases, not a substitute for strict-convexity argument.
